slides.decision_reason: 일반명사 PRD와 이 수업의 prd.md를 같은 문서로 오인하기 쉬워, 두꺼운 문서 더미(PRD)와 다섯 칸 얇은 파일(prd.md)의 크기 대비를 비교표 두 열 머리 사이에 두어 구분을 보강한다. 2026-09-11 W2 부활(원본 바이브코딩 2주차 C3-N1·C3-2 병합) — 원본 슬롯의 기존 PNG를 그대로 재사용하며 신규 생성·변형 0장.

brief.learning_point: The general concept of a PRD, a thick multi-team planning document, is different from prd.md in this course, a thin file with just five slots to fill.
brief.source_metaphor: A thick, multi-layered paper stack labeled for many teams, beside one thin single sheet with exactly five small filled slots.

metaphor_mapping.concept: the general concept of a PRD used across many teams in organizations

metaphor_mapping.visual: one thin single sheet with five small filled slots
metaphor_mapping.concept: prd.md, this course's five-item file read by the Coding Agent

metaphor_mapping.visual: a clear size contrast between the stack and the sheet
metaphor_mapping.concept: they are related by name only, not the same document

must_show: one thin sheet with five small filled slots
a clear size contrast between them
